newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's CEI denies buys media stake.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's CEI denies buys media stake.

text.p: Argentina's CEI Citicorp Holdings SA denied Wednesday it has bought 40 percent of media holding Grupo Federal de Communicaciones as reported in a local newspaper.

Business daily El Cronista said in a report Wednesday that CEI had acquired a 40 percent stake in the group for $200 million. Grupo Federal comprises television channel Telefe, Radio Continental and publisher Editorial Atlantida.

But CEI said in a statement to the Buenos Aires Stock Exchange that "We deny the information published in El Cronista which says that CEI has acquired 40 percent of Telefe, Radio Continental and Editorial Atlantida."

Editorial Atlantida SA said in a separate statement to the exchange that "A group of majority shareholders told the company that it is their intention to maintain their majority holding and maintain management control of the company."
CEI is about 40 percent indirectly owned by Citicorp.
Earlier this week, CEI signed a preliminary deal with Tele-Communications International Inc and Eduardo Eurnekian to buy 64.5 percent of Argentine cable television operator Cablevision SA.
It also bought 33.34 percent of television sports channel and producer Torneos y Competencias.
